process.title: How we work
process.subtitle: Clear steps, fixed price per step, and a live demo every two weeks.

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: We learn your business, users and goals, and agree on a clear scope.

steps.title: Plan & design
steps.text: You see and try every screen before a line of code is written.

steps.title: Build in steps
steps.text: We deliver small releases you can review and use early.

steps.title: Validate
steps.text: We test on real devices and with real users before every release.

steps.title: Deliver & support
steps.text: We launch, train your team, and stay to maintain and improve.

experience.title: Experience you can rely on
experience.text: Led by an engineer who has built government-scale, bilingual, multi-role platforms, with a team experienced in fintech and high-traffic products.

solutions.title: End-to-end solutions
solutions.text: We take products from first idea to production: discovery, UX, frontend, APIs, integrations and launch, delivered by one accountable team. You get a complete, maintainable solution, not disconnected pieces.

fintech.title: Fintech & digital payments
fintech.text: Our team has shipped consumer fintech in Egypt and internationally, including InstaPay and Phi Wallet: instant transfers, bill payments, identity verification and digital gold trading, built with security first.

about.title: About the studio
about.tagline: Senior engineers. Startup speed. Software built to last.
about.intro: Rakeez Tech started with a simple belief: every business deserves the kind of engineering usually reserved for big tech. Our team has built government-scale platforms, fintech apps and high-traffic media products, and we bring that same standard to every client, from the first idea to launch day. You work directly with the people building your product, with clear communication, honest timelines and code that is easy to grow.
